en-US.description: Fast desktop video downloader for YouTube and 1000+ sites
en-US.longDescription: Yalla Video is an Electron desktop app for downloading videos from YouTube and 1000+ other sites. Supports playlists, full channels, quality up to 8K, audio-only formats, and multi-language subtitles. yt-dlp and ffmpeg are bundled.
